programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Kom helt tæt på trænerteamet i 29 intense og fokuserede dage, når Superliga-truppen gøres klar til forårspremieren. Oplev forberedelserne, beslutningerne og pulsen bag kulisserne, hvor hver detalje tæller frem mod den første kamp.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Martin Retov sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som først bød på en årrække som spiller og siden som træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Mogens Krogh sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Spørg Løs!
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne, hvem der ville vinde Tour de France, hvem de ville stemme på som statsminister – og hvem der er bedst i et køkken. Du får også deres bud på yndlingsmusik, idoler og drømme uden for fodbolden.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du med bag kulisserne til opgøret i Viborg og sejrene i Aarhus og Silkeborg. Oplev intensiteten, stemningen og de afgørende øjeblikke, når Brøndby jagter point på tre svære udebaner i Superligaen.

programme.title: Sportsdirektørerne
programme.desc: I andet afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne fortsætter fortællingerne fra direktionsgangen på Vestegnen, hvor der reflekteres over store beslutninger, særlige øjeblikke og den evige tilknytning til Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' står den på EM-special og spillet 'Kend Din Holdkammerat'. Spillerne tester deres viden om hinanden og landsholdets store scene – med masser af grin, overraskelser og kamp om håneretten.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' møder du de nye forsvarsspillere Rasmus Lauritsen og Frederik Winther, hører Thomas Mikkelsen sætte ord på rollen som erfaren sidste skanse – og følger Joe Bells rejse og refleksioner i Brøndby-trøjen.

programme.title: Reservemålmændene
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Reservemålmændene' følger vi livet som målmand i skyggen af førstevalget. Hør om ankomsten til Brøndby IF, rollen som reserve og de største oplevelser – fortalt af dem, der altid er klar, men sjældent i rampelyset.

programme.title: Quizhjørnet
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Quizhjørnet' gælder det EAFC 24 og det evige rivalopgør. Spillerne tester hinanden i 'Gæt en spiller' og dyster i en intens Derby Special, hvor både viden og håneret er på spil – og hvor konkurrencen når nye højder.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du Oscar Schwartau i 'Drengene fra Vestegnen'. Hør om rejsen fra ungdomsårene til gennembruddet i Superligaen – og hvad det betyder at repræsentere Brøndby IF som en af klubbens egne.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Ole Bjur sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' følger du Henrik Heggheims rejse fra Stavanger til Brøndby IF. Hør om overgangen til dansk fodbold, tilværelsen på Vestegnen og de oplevelser, der har formet ham som spiller og menneske i den gule trøje.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Oplev et følelsesladet og nostalgisk tilbageblik på mesterskabet, ingen troede muligt. Hør historierne bag sæsonen, der kulminerede i Brøndby IF’s første triumf i 16 år – fortalt af dem, der selv var med til at skrive historien.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Bent 'Turbo' Christensen Arensøes målrige karriere i Brøndby IF. Med fem mesterskaber, to pokaltitler og tre topscorertitler skrev han sig ind i historien – både som spiller og træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I sæsonpremieren af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Kim Vilforts 12 år i Brøndby IF – fra præsentationen i 1986 til den sidste kamp i 1998. Hør om de største kampe, titlerne og øjeblikkene, der gjorde ham til en af klubbens største profiler.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du helt tæt på den intense derbysejr og med bag kulisserne til kampen i Aalborg, hvor du oplever stemningen, forberedelserne og øjeblikkene, der definerede to af sæsonens mest nervepirrende opgør.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Morten Wieghorst sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Sportsdirektørerne
programme.desc: I første afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne møder vi tre tidligere sportsdirektører i Brøndby IF, der åbent deler deres oplevelser fra livet bag kulisserne i en af Danmarks største fodboldklubber.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I sæsonafslutningen af 'Vores Brøndby' hyldes klubben i en kærlighedserklæring. Med Rasmus Hammerich og Kim Vilfort taler panelet om, hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget – for fans og spillere – og hvad der gør klubben helt særlig.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Marko Divkovic om skiftet fra angreb til forsvar, Daniel Wass deler sine tanker om rollen som playmaker, og Jonathan Ægidius giver et indblik i konkurrencen og kampen om pladsen mellem stængerne.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du status fra Jesper Sørensen og spillerne Rasmussen, Kvistgaarden, Bischoff og Rajović. Hør deres refleksioner om sæsonen, præstationerne og hvad der venter forude i jagten på succes.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Frederik Alves om at gribe chancen, Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer sin milepæl med 50 kampe i gult og blåt, og Rasmus Lauritsen ser tilbage på sin startdebut i Brøndby IF-trøjen.

programme.title: Fraklip
programme.desc: I 'Fraklip fra året der gik' får du de sjoveste øjeblikke fra Brøndby IF, der aldrig nåede skærmen. Grin med, når spillerne snubler i replikkerne, joker bag kulisserne og viser deres menneskelige side fra træningslejre, interviews og hverdagen.
programme.sub-title: Afsnit 1: Fraklip fra året der gik - #1-5

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I 'Vores Brøndby' får det faste hold besøg af Noah Nartey til en snak om livet som prof i dag vs. 90’erne. De vender krav, mediepres og træningskultur, før ung mod gammel klæder to giner i hjemme- og udebanesæt.

programme.title: Udfordringen
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' skyder spillerne Black Friday-rabatter i No Bounce Challenge, mens Alves, Cappis og Maxsø dyster i tre intense udfordringer. Til sidst gælder det præcision og pres i en klassisk crossbar challenge.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Jordi Vanlerberghe om sit første derby, Frederik Birk giver et indblik i rollen som assistenttræner, og Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer en stor milepæl med sine første 100 kampe for Brøndby IF.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I 'Vores Brøndby' gæster Nikolaj Koppel og sætter ord på fankulturen: fællesskab, traditioner og hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget for så mange. Til sidst udfordres han til at spille “Jump” på et virkelig dårligt legetøjskeyboard.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Følg med, når Joel Kabongo tager mikrofonen og guider dig gennem en helt almindelig træning med Superliga-truppen en januareftermiddag. Få et unikt indblik i tempoet, stemningen og detaljerne, der præger hverdagen på træningsbanen.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuántos años han pasado desde que se transmitió el último episodio de Cybernet? Desde entonces han habido muchos cambios en los videojuegos. Acompáñanos a través de un recuento de lo más importante que ocurrió durante nuestra ausencia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Si eres fan de los videojuegos, probablemente también te gusten los juegos con gráficas retro en pixeles. Hacemos un recuento de los juegos modernos que lucen como clásicos, así como un Top 10 de nuestros soundtracks en chiptunes favoritos.

programme.title: Cybernet LT

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuánto dinero estarían dispuestos a pagar por su juego favorito? En el capítulo de hoy les contaremos cuáles han sido los juegos que más caro se han vendido en la historia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Saben qué es una secuela espiritual? Lo descubriremos en éste episodio de Cybernet. También conoceremos los mejores crossovers de los videojuegos en nuestro Top 10 y recordaremos algunos de los mejores juegos basados en películas.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Abran muy bien los ojos y pongan mucha atención, ya que hoy hablaremos de los secretos y easter eggs más famosos de los videojuegos. Conoceremos algunos de los juegos cancelados que más nos han dolido.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Tenemos que admitir que no todos los videojuegos son de buena calidad, y algunos de ellos son tan malos que se han vuelto de culto. En el episodio de hoy de Cybernet recordaremos a los peores juegos de la historia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Bienvenidos al especial de The Legend of Zelda de Cybernet. Haremos un recuento por la evolución de una de las series más famosas de la historia y en nuestro Top 10 recordaremos a los mejores jefes de la franquicia.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Bienvenidos al especial de The Legend of Zelda de Cybernet. Haremos un recuento por la evolución de una de las series más famosas de la historia y en nuestro Top 10 recordaremos a los mejores jefes de la franquicia.

programme.sub-title: Historia de los Juegos en Primera Persona.

S01 E05 — Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Best of Salina's Land and Sea Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Italian Alps Comfort Food Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Getting Started in the Kitchen Gordon teaches you how to get started in the kitchen by cooking delicious pork chops with sweet and sour peppers, pan-fried scallops with crunchy apple salad and a tip that will help you keep your knives sharp.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Real Fast Food Gordon makes real fast food with recipes for smoky pork sliders with homemade BBQ sauce, chicken stir-fry with rice noodles, and a fast noodle soup with poached egg and spring onions.
programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Inspirational Spanish Tapas Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Stunning Seafood of Marseille Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Making Couscous in Tunisia Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Traditional Greek Cuisine Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E01 — West Tennessee Whole Hog Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Backyard Cabrito Asado in Texas Jess joins her friend Javi in his backyard, where he welds custom cooking contraptions, including an asado cross they use to cook cabrito together.

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S24 E156 — Mother/Daughter Takedown of Used Car Salesman?! Two women are caught on video chasing down a man in his place of business after he repossesses the car they bought.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E157 — Recipe for Childcare Disaster!; Frat Brother Fight! A mother of five deals with escalating family drama. A student who failed his fraternity GPA requirement is sued by his former frat brothers over rent and unpaid bills.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E158 — Honey, Can My Ex-Lover Move In?; Grandmother Charges for Daycare?! A crazy living arrangement does not work out, and ex-lovers are left fighting over stolen property and tow fees. While a woman's son is in prison, she helps to care for her grandson, then slaps the child's mother with a bill for her services.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E159 — Homeland Security Fraud?!; Where's My Rottweiler Puppy?! An unsuspecting, older couple get the shock of their lives when they are pulled over by police for driving an allegedly stolen vehicle.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E25 — Teen Lies to Police!; Rodent Disposal Fee Fight! A teenager claims he took the fall for a friend after a car accident; a woman sues her step granddaughter for unpaid rent and rodent disposal fees.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E26 — Stealing From the Disabled?!; Stalking and Harassment?! A woman accuses her ex-landlord of stealing rent from her disability account and evicting her; a man says he wants his belongings back from his ex-lover, especially his beloved barbecue.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E85 — Boys Just Wanna Have Guns; Minor Car Collision A man says his daughter's boyfriend stole a gun from his home and owes him for a polygraph test. Then, a defendant blames a plaintiff's teen daughter for a car accident.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E98 — Mexico Timeshare Ex-Lovers; The Manny A woman learns her fiance vacationed in a timeshare with another woman. Then, a man sues his former employer for unpaid babysitting fees and missing belongings, while she countersues for costs to change her locks.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E31 — Ex-Son in Law Trucker; Sibling Bad Blood A couple sue their ex-son in-law, and a woman sues her brother for supporting their mother.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E43 — Girls' Weekend Gone Wild; Abandoned Dog A wild weekend ends with destruction to hotel property, a vandalised car and a fight over liability. A landlord and former tenant argue over a motorcycle, unpaid rent and an abandoned dog.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E61 — Target Practice Vandalism; Ex-Girlfriend Warrant A woman accuses four men of shooting up her car during target practice; an ex-lover sues a terminally ill woman for rent, bail and late fees.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E63 — Windshield Wiper Attack; Crash, Brake and Bills A teen says her ex-boyfriend vandalised her vehicle during a drunken argument; a woman sues her ex for totalling her car, but he says she is at fault for the crash and sues her for medical bills.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E65 — Fake Designer Bag Scam? Buyer and seller dispute whether a designer handbag is fake or real.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E67 — Risque Internet Pics; Terrorist Facebook Threats A plaintiff says her ex-boyfriend vandalised her car and posted risque photos of her online; a woman says her former friend had her falsely arrested for making terrorist threats.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E54 — Racism and Trans-Gender Hate? A couple says a neighbour came at them with a knife after a dispute over a parking space; they accuse each other of prejudice.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E60 — Payback for Bailout; Valentine's Day Warrant Pay-Off Friends regret bailing a woman out of jail and a teen regrets lending money to her then boyfriend so he could pay off a warrant.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E30 — Knife Fight Threat!; Meter Fraud?! An alleged eye bite leads to a knife fight; a woman says her landlord charges her too much for utilities, while he claims she stole property.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E27 — Ex-Wife Gets the Pit Bull?; Mercedes Custody Battle A truck driver wants his dog back from his uncaring ex-wife; a woman says a used Mercedes she gave to a friend now sits abandoned and uninsured.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E28 — Pot-Bellied Pig Bite!; Two Bedrooms Too Small! A fight over an alleged pig attack on a Great Dane; a case involves an illegal eviction, alleged threats and an assault when a nurse takes on a new roommate.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E29 — Arkansas Handyman Hustle?!; Mobile Homelessness? Substandard work leads a couple to sue a handyman, who says they still owe him money; a homeless man and his friend argue over stolen tools.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E31 — Retirement Payday Fail!; Teen Drives Into Wall! A man's ex-lover wants repayment of a sizeable loan; a teen is accused of driving his sister's car through a bedroom wall.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: Murder On The Bridge The tragic case of John Chipp who was thrown 85ft to his death after a night out in Sunderland.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: Murder of a Showgirl Geoffrey Wansell explores the case of George Shotton, who murdered his wife near Swansea in 1919. Features expert interviews.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: Manslaughter To Murder A man is stabbed while running to the aid of a neighbour who's being burgled in Hertfordshire and bleeds to death. The killer is a double murderer out on day release.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: The Party Killer Geoffrey Wansell revisits how Charlotte Pinkney vanished from Ilfracombe after going to a party. Police launched a hunt when her handbag was found.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: Murderous Bigamist Geoffrey Wansell explores the case of Pierre Le Gris, who reports his wife missing in Dorset and police are instantly wary.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: Child Killers Simon Toyne travels to Liverpool to unravel the notorious story of the murder of James Bulger, who was abducted and killed by two 10-year-old boys.
programme.title: UK Crime Files

programme.desc: S3 E5 — A Father's Deadly Deception Dawn Rhodes was murdered in Earlswood by her husband after an affair. Acquitted in 2017, he was retried and jailed for life in 2025 after the truth emerged.
programme.title: Britain's Countryside Killers

programme.desc: S1 E5 — Rocky Mountain Murder Two Colorado women are murdered during a camping honeymoon in Utah. Detectives hunt a 'creepy camper'.
programme.title: Deadly Destinations

programme.desc: S6 E11 — Adopted by Death A 65-year-old mystery is solved when DNA testing identifies the remains of seven-year-old Chester Alfred Breiney.
programme.title: Bloodline Detectives

programme.desc: S24 E155 — Family Unprepared for Father's Sudden Death; Everything but the Kitchen Sink! Sisters pull together to pay for their father's funeral only to be pulled apart by life-insurance delays. A woman sues her sister for repossession fees, damages from a car accident and a fraudulent tax return.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S21 E43 — Crock of Baloney!; Pit Bull Chomps Chihuahua! A former talent partner refuses to accept that she is technically a squatter; an 8-year-old girl tells how her little dog was attacked by a pit bull.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E181 — Family Uproar Over Nursing-Home Wedding?!; No One Scams Judge Judy! When a man passes away, his family contests and nullifies his recent wedding and sues his partner for allegedly stealing property. A man accuses his nephew of stealing and crashing his Jaguar.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E182 — Mercedes Benz Tug-of-War!; German Wirehaired Pointer Puppy Fail! A businessman sues a friend over severe car damage. A mother's festive surprise unravels when a breeder fails to deliver a Christmas puppy.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E184 — Screaming Fit Freaks Mom Out!; No Shopping Together When You're Playing House!; Dominican Republic Nightmare! A landlord says ex-tenants left lice and bedbugs behind. When a romance falls apart, a dog is caught in the middle. After fracturing her back, a woman complains her way through a family holiday and refuses to pay for her share of the trip.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E185 — Instagram Influencer's Sweet Tooth?!; Leave My Child Support Out of This! A social media personality invests in a candy company, but the minute he begins promotions, his business partner goes missing. A man insists that a payout from a car accident has nothing to do with a loan from a woman who was interested in him.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E186 — Mom Gave My Dog Away!; Buy What You Can Afford!; Frightening Dental Scare?! A woman loses her dog to her mother. A teen is betrayed by her brother over a co-signed loan. A woman with severe tooth pain gets support from an ex-lover.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E187 — Shocking Vandalism Caught on Tape!; Don't Lay Your Hands on a Minor! A woman is caught on tape bashing the windows and slashing the tires of a car that hit hers. programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S24 E183 — I'm a Cash Guy, Not a Tax Guy! A man who admits he doesn't pay taxes sues a former friend for the return of property and for allegedly filing a false police report.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E59 — Punch Truck Love; College Athletes Fear Marijuana Exposure A teen says his ex-girlfriend's new boyfriend vandalised his truck. College athletes say they had to move because their landlord's son smoked marijuana.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E82 — Domestic Dispute A man denies breaking his ex-fiancée's wrist during an argument involving rent money and accusations of infidelity.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E81 — Vacuum Cleaner Caper; Bridesmaid Dress Disaster Former roommates fight over damages caused by a car accident. A newlywed sues her former bridesmaid following a dispute over the cost of bridesmaid dresses.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: S17 E66 — Vow Renewal Video up in Flames; Arrest and Sexual Advances? A bride sues her wedding coordinator because the video of her ceremony was destroyed in a house fire. A landlord accuses a former tenant of sexual abuse.
programme.title: Judge Judy

programme.desc: For the past 2000 years, he has remained the most famous character of History. Described as a leader, as a feminist, an anarchist, a healer. But today, what do we really know about Jesus?
programme.title: In the Footsteps of Jesus

programme.desc: For more than 2000 years, he has been the most discussed character in History. What do we really know about Jesus today?
programme.title: The Miracles of Jesus

programme.desc: In Judaism, it’s the most sacred object. A chest carved in acacia wood, gilded with gold leaf, and topped by two cherubs. The Ark of the Covenant strikes down the Mortal who touches it.
programme.title: The Quest for the Ark of the Covenant

programme.desc: It’s the most desired and sacred relic in Christianity. However, this artefact is shrouded in mystery. No one can say what it looks like. Today, dozens of churches claim to hold the Grail.
programme.title: The Quest for the Grail

programme.desc: Solomon is a mythical figure of the Old Testament. Third king of Israel, he reigned from 970 to 931 BC. But did he really exist?
programme.title: The Power of King Solomon

programme.desc: The Shrine of Fatima in Portugal is one of the most visited pilgrimage sites in the world. More than 6 million visitors come every year to take a moment in this place.
programme.title: The Mystery of Fátima

programme.desc: In 1959 the USA decided to build a military town under the ice sheet of North Greenland. The superpower wanted to use all its might to gain a strategic advantage over the Soviet Union.
programme.title: Camp Century

programme.desc: What was life like behind a castle walls? The documentary follows their development from simple wooden fortifications to the most elaborate strongholds and residences.
programme.title: Life behind the Walls of Europe's Castles

programme.desc: Castles were bastions of power. Yet, what if the enemy was at the gates? Our documentary examines the military function of castles from the 11th to the 16th century.
programme.title: Enemy at the Gate

programme.desc: Under the influence of changing rulers and empires, the country’s structure is formed over centuries as home to five nationalities with three languages and four different religions.
programme.title: Tinderbox Yugoslavia

programme.desc: We are in the fateful year of Yugoslavia’s first free elections since World War II: 1990. It is the hour of the nationalists.
programme.title: A State Falls Apart

programme.desc: The Srebrenica massacre is a wake-up call for the international community, which decides to intervene after four years of war. That same year, the warring parties sign a peace treaty.
programme.title: Yugoslavia in Ruins

programme.desc: The documentary THE BALKANS IN FLAMES examines the disintegration of the former Socialist Federation of Yugoslavia.
programme.title: The Balkans in Flames

programme.desc: The Rise of Judea explores the tumultuous reign of King Herod and the ascent of Roman stewardship in Judea through the words of Flavius Josephus.
programme.title: The Rise of Judea

programme.desc: The Fatal Conflict Episode 2 explores the events that shaped the great Jewish revolt against Rome, as recorded by Jewish General, historian and perceived traitor, Flavius Josephus.
programme.title: The Fall of Judea

programme.desc: At the beginning of the 12th century, a few knights decide to create a new brotherhood called "The order of the Temple".
programme.title: Birth of a Brotherhood

programme.desc: In the middle of the 12th century, the order of the Temple becomes increasingly popular among the kings and peoples of Western Europe.
programme.title: A business empire

programme.desc: At the end of the 13th century, as Christian holdings in the holy land have disappeared, the Templars continue to push for a new crusade.
programme.title: The fall of the order

programme.desc: For the past 2000 years, he has remained the most famous character of History. Described as a leader, as a feminist, an anarchist, a healer. But today, what do we really know about Jesus?
programme.title: In the Footsteps of Jesus

programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.
programme.title: The East

programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.
programme.title: The West

programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.
programme.title: Crime in Post-War Germany

programme.desc: Discover how agents tricked the Germans to keep their troops out of Normandy.
programme.title: The D-Days Spies

programme.desc: Discover a darkly humorous British ploy that helped the 1943 landing in Sicily.
programme.title: The Soldier who never was

programme.desc: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.
programme.title: The Spy who Saved the World

programme.desc: Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.
programme.title: The A-Bomb Spies

programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.
programme.title: Part 1

programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.
programme.title: Part 2

programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.
programme.title: The Maya

programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.
programme.title: The Aztecs

programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.
programme.title: The Incas

programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!
programme.title: First Before Columbus

programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.
programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun

programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World

programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World

programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World

Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hook, Line & Printer
programme.desc: A last-minute auction in Norwalk proves challenging when Ton and Allen go toe-to-toe with a real life cowboy couple. When the dust settles, the guys uncover a 3D printer and a grappling hook gun they can't wait to shoot.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Machine Gun Ton
programme.desc: Ton and Allen battle a pair of vicious female auction hunters who have an axe to grind and bid based on spite rather than strategy. And a gatling gun & suit of armor are worth much less than the guys expected.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Risk & Reward
programme.desc: Ton & Allen arrive late to an auction. They uncover vintage bear traps and a bounty of street art. If the pieces belong to the artist, RISK, it could be their biggest score ever. If not, they'll be stuck with forged knockoffs.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Space Cowboys
programme.desc: With the pawn shop history, Ton and Allen start the next chapter of their careers with a bang. They uncover an antique WWII firearm and a Russian cosmonaut space suit, which could be their biggest find to date...if it's real.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton Voyage
programme.desc: When a ruthless storeowner seems hell-bent on stopping Ton & Allen from scoring new items in Santa Barbara they fight back. The guys uncover a rare antique air-gun and a vintage wooden boat built for speed, if it floats!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangster Whiskey
programme.desc: Allen and Ton trek to an auction in Moreno Valley, CA, where two locker wins yield a vintage jukebox, a valuable baseball card and a Prohibition-era moonshine still.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Whip It Good
programme.desc: With a motocross bike and a rare stock whip up for grabs, Ton and Allen face one of their toughest competitors yet: their former employee Carolyn, who knows all their tricks, has money to burn and is out for revenge.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Fall Guys
programme.desc: The pressures of running a shop are taking a toll on Ton and Allen and not even the discovery of a stunt-man's fall bag can ease the tension. When things get heated, Ton abandons the partnership and leaves town.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: You Foos You Lose
